local_patch.description: Use the actual returned video/audio tensor width for PDD final all-gather, and use the public all_gather_into_tensor API supported by the installed PyTorch 2.12.0+cu130 runtime. Padding, rank order and float32 gather buffers are unchanged.
changes: final row gather API: dist.all_gather_single -> dist.all_gather_into_tensor
world1-only identity collective branches for failed-verification mirror probe; world2 collectives unchanged
For world2 block projections only, synchronize dynamic NVFP4 activation amax across ranks before original quantize; fixed input scales and weight requantization retain native behavior
Verification only: sample fixed seven global rows per rank around block0 projections and compare to native first forward; no tensor samples written or logged

validation.scope: First-forward global-amax GPU diagnostic failed unchanged 1e-3 gate; block0 sampled-row trace candidate awaits GPU validation.

scope: Candidate for a separately labelled two-GPU SP diagnostic; no measured speed or full-model equivalence claim.

diagnostic_patch.scope: Existing verify mode logs both streams. On failed SP2/native parity only, run one world1 SP mirror before rejecting with the unchanged 1e-3 threshold. No formal-path extra forward. Verification also logs block0 sampled-row scalar summaries; incomplete trace fails closed. Formal forwards have no trace hooks or extra collective.

activation_scale_patch.scope: SP world2 50 blocks x qkv_proj/out_proj/fc1/fc2 only
activation_scale_patch.rank_preflight: same target names, dimensions and dynamic/fixed input-scale status
activation_scale_patch.restoration: scope finally restores original classmethod and module forward attributes before final heads and native oracle
activation_scale_patch.replaces: rank-local dynamic activation scale in the original Ulysses candidate; numerical gate unchanged

block0_diagnostic_patch.scope: verify mode first SP2 forward only
block0_diagnostic_patch.comparison: same global rows, all features; samples are internal CPU copies; logs contain only scalar summaries and row/shape metadata
block0_diagnostic_patch.limitations: Sampled rows do not prove full-layer equivalence; out_proj.pre combines qk norm, RoPE, communication and attention.
block0_diagnostic_patch.cleanup: forward hooks removed in scope finally; samples discarded before failure mirror; caller options never contain trace state
